breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 高致死实体瘤微环境破壁与普惠早筛
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 告别“一经发现即晚期”，打破难治肿瘤的免疫屏障
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 胰腺癌、肝癌、晚期肺癌、卵巢癌等之所以致死率极高，核心在于早期几乎没有特异性感觉、发现太晚，且肿瘤被致密纤维基质与免疫抑制“盾牌”死死裹住。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推动一滴血极早期泛癌种微创早筛降本普及，开发打破癌巢基质屏障的新型核素偶联/双抗药物、通用型细胞免疫疗法与耐药逃逸实时监测。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 低丰度循环肿瘤 DNA/表观甲基化早筛模型、肿瘤空间微环境耐药逆转靶点挖掘。

master.definition_en: A condition characterized by an increase in mononuclear white blood cells and swollen lymph nodes, which is usually caused by infection with the Epstein-Barr virus.

curated.name_zh: 传染性单核细胞增多症
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 99%以上患者呈良性自限经过；但急性期脾脏迅速肿大充血、包膜极薄且脆弱，若在发病3–4周内剧烈运动或腹部受撞击，约0.1%–0.5%患者可突发致命性【自发或外伤性脾破裂大出血】，数小时内即可因失血性休克死亡（占该病致死主要原因）；极少数还可并发嗜血细胞综合征（HLH）或上气道梗阻。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 多为自限性临床治愈（2–4周退热恢复）；以休息、对症退热及严格避坑（禁剧烈运动防脾破裂、禁滥用阿莫西林防药疹）为核心，重症伴上气道梗阻或血小板极低者短期用糖皮质激素。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: 全球超过90%成人曾感染EB病毒，但传单总体病死率极低（<0.1%），全球及中国官方死因统计均未单列；偶发死亡主要源于急性脾破裂大出血或继发EBV相关嗜血细胞综合征。

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国未单列独立死亡人数；国内儿童传单临床极常见且住院率较高，严防误诊滥用抗生素及运动致脾破裂是关键。

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 欧美多高发于15–25岁青少年与大学生；全球终生EBV血清阳性率超90%。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 与欧美不同，中国住院传染性单核细胞增多症发病高峰明显前移，主要集中在4–6岁学龄前儿童（幼儿园聚集期），是儿科发热伴淋巴结肿大的最常见病因之一。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 120一分钟识别与避坑：传单患者在发病1个月内，若突然出现左上腹剧烈疼痛、疼痛向左肩部放射（Kehr征）、面色苍白、出冷汗、头晕心慌（脾破裂内出血信号！），或扁桃体极度肿大导致仰卧呼吸困难、张口喘鸣，立即拨打120！家长必知两大避坑红线：1) 确诊后至少3–4周内（直至超声确认脾脏回缩至正常）绝对禁止跑步、跳绳、踢球、对抗性运动及腹部按压；2) 极易被误诊为化脓性扁桃体炎，严禁使用氨苄西林或阿莫西林（可诱发全身剧烈超敏药疹！）。

non_drug_therapies_zh: 发病后至少3–4周内严格限制体育课、跑跳、骑车及撞击性运动，需经腹部B超复查确认脾脏完全回缩正常后方可恢复运动
注意唾液飞沫防护：避免与婴幼儿共用餐具或嘴对嘴亲吻喂食

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 针对EB病毒（不仅是传单，更关系鼻咽癌、淋巴瘤及多发性硬化）的预防性疫苗已迎来突破，Moderna mRNA-1189疫苗及gp350铁蛋白纳米颗粒疫苗正处于I/II期临床试验，旨在阻断原发EBV感染及传单发病。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 临床尚无特效抗EB病毒药物，重症免疫异常（如慢性活动性EBV感染CAEBV及HLH）病死率极高; 2) 基层医院极易将传单误诊为急性化脓性扁桃体炎并处方阿莫西林引发药疹; 3) 尚无获批上市的EBV预防疫苗。

master.definition_en: Hypothalamic hamartomas (HH) are rare, tumor-like malformations that occur during fetal development and are present at birth. The lesions usually do not change in size or spread to other locations. Both the type and severity of symptoms vary greatly among patients with hypothalamic hamartomas. Common symptoms include frequent gelastic seizures (spontaneous laughing, giggling and/or smirking) or dacrystic seizures (crying or grunting); developmental delays; and/or precocious puberty. Additional symptoms may include cognitive impairment; emotional and behavioral difficulties; and endocrine disturbances. These symptoms often start early in life but are frequently misdiagnosed. For some patients, endocrine (hormonal) disturbances such as central precocious puberty may be the only symptom. These patients can often be treated successfully with medications. For some, however, HH can be disabling. For those with HH and epilepsy, it is common for the disorder to progress and for different types of seizures to develop. The seizures associated with HH often cannot be well-controlled with the standard seizure medications. For some, additional treatment such as surgical removal, radiosurgery, or thermoablation may be indicated. Though hypothalamic hamartomas can occur in patients with certain genetic disorders (such as Pallister-Hall syndrome), the majority of cases are sporadic.

master.definition_en: Klumpke paralysis is a type of brachial palsy in newborns. Signs and symptoms include weakness and loss of movement of the arm and hand. Some babies experience drooping of the eyelid on the opposite side of the face as well. This symptom may also be referred to as Horner syndrome. Klumpke paralysis is caused by an injury to the nerves of the brachial plexus which may result from a difficult delivery. This injury can cause a stretching (neuropraxia), tearing (called avulsion when the tear is at the spine, and rupture when it is not), or scarring (neuroma) of the brachial plexus nerves. Most infants with Klumpke paralysis have the more mild form of injury (neuropraxia) and often recover within 6 months.
synonyms_en: Paralysis of the Lower Brachial Plexus

master.definition_en: A rare gastroenterologic disease characterized by the histopathological finding of a thickened (> 10 µm) gastric subepithelial collagen layer in association with an inflammatory infiltrate in the lamina propria. Patients typically present with upper abdominal pain and severe iron deficiency anemia. The condition is not commonly associated with autoimmune diseases, and involvement of the colon is less frequent than in the adult form.
